svg.desc: Map of central Geneva. 11 markers show international organisations headquartered in the city, coloured by category: 4 UN system agencies in blue, 5 other intergovernmental bodies in orange and 2 other international bodies in green. Colour is not position: 9 of the markers, from all three categories, sit together within 1.5 km of the United Nations Office at Geneva, while 2 stand alone in the frame and are labelled beside their own points — the World Economic Forum (other international body) 4.2 km east and the International Civil Defence Organisation (other intergovernmental) 4.0 km south of that cluster.
svg.text: organisations within 6 km of central Geneva · basemap
A locator marks position only — marker size does not encode a
value. Coordinates are the organisation's own Wikidata point,
not a street address. 9 of the 11 sit within 1.3 km of their
common centre; 2 stand apart from that cluster: the World
Economic Forum 4.2 km east and the International Civil
Defence Organisation 4.0 km south, both labelled on the map.
